dates.notes: Signed at Tbilisi on 3 July 2026. Article 10 provides that the Agreement enters into force on the date of signature; the Matsne record gives an activating date of 3 July 2026 and publication on 9 July 2026.

languages.note: Article 10 states that the Agreement is done in Georgian, Uzbek and English, all texts being equally authentic, and that the English text prevails in case of divergence. Only the English text was read.

legal_nature.rationale: An international agreement between two Governments with final provisions, entry into force on signature, a four-year term with automatic renewal, and termination by diplomatic notification. Georgia registers it as an International Treaty and Agreement. The AI references are cooperative obligations inside a binding treaty, not a separate AI-specific regime.

accessions.note: Bilateral agreement; no accession procedure or third-party accession is recorded.

ratifications.note: Article 10 provides entry into force on signature; no separate ratification tally is maintained.

parties.summary: Two Parties: Georgia and Uzbekistan. The Agreement entered into force on signature on 3 July 2026; no depositary register, ratification tally or accession procedure is maintained.

ai_provisions: Preamble: the Parties recognise their mutual interest in expanding cooperation in areas including artificial intelligence.
Article 2: the Parties are to encourage cooperation between relevant organisations, universities and businesses in information technology, postal services, artificial intelligence and digitalization.

Article 2, final paragraph: the Parties agree to support projects in areas including the application of artificial intelligence, provided that they do not contradict their commitments under other international treaties.
relevance.excluded_scope: The Agreement's object is cooperation in ICTs, digitalization, innovations and postal services. AI is one cooperative area, not a dedicated AI treaty, and the text creates no AI-specific prohibition, standard, market-access condition or enforcement mechanism.
relevance.reason: A binding bilateral agreement with express AI cooperation provisions. It is the first binding bilateral instrument in the corpus connecting Central Asia and the Caucasus with AI, but its AI clauses are programmatic and cooperative.

status_note: In force between Georgia and Uzbekistan on signature, 3 July 2026, under Article 10; the Matsne record gives an activating date of 3 July 2026. Two Parties and no accessions. The Agreement replaces the 1995 bilateral telecommunications agreement. No depositary register or separate ratification process is maintained.
